footer.about_text: An integrated creative studio merging the authenticity of architecture & interior design with powerful digital branding & web experiences.

about.heading: We Merge Art and Engineering to Craft Exceptional Spaces
about.sub: Founded in 2018, Ammar Studio is a creative hub integrating authentic architecture and interior design with modern digital solutions. We believe physical spaces and digital experiences complement each other to build unforgettable brands.

timeline.title: Studio Foundation
timeline.body: We started as a small architectural team aiming to reshape traditional residential and commercial spaces.

timeline.title: Interior Design Expansion
timeline.body: We introduced interior design and turn-key furnishing services to deliver complete spatial experiences.

timeline.title: Going Digital (Graphic & Web)
timeline.body: We expanded our vision by incorporating premium branding and web development services to support corporate digital transformation.

timeline.title: Regional Leadership & Innovation
timeline.body: Today, we stand as a premier creative studio delivering physical and digital design harmony under one roof.
